title: A stats panel
description:
Turn telemetry samples from your game into the numbers and text a stats panel shows.

```
FPS 143 (min 120)   frame 6.9 ms
Player  (12.5, 4.0)  hp 17/20 [#################   ]
Enemies 3   Bullets 41
memory  212 MB (+4 in the last 10 s)
```
hints: A bar of 20 characters has `hp * 20 / maxHp` filled ones (lesson 12.05).
Find the sample closest to `now - 10` for the "change" numbers.
requirements: Input: a list of telemetry samples over time (from the previous projects).
Show the latest values, a health bar, and changes over the last 10 seconds.
Mark stale data (no sample for 2 seconds) instead of showing old numbers as current.
stretch: Draw the same panel with Dear ImGui in a separate tool window.
